fnol_text: My name is Anika Al-Sayed and I live at 50 Ashford Street, Clinton, NC 28387. You can reach me on (555) 745-2564 or anika.alsayed@example.com. On 30 September 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2024-00083. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Al-Sayed on (555) 745-2564 to acknowledge the claim. Anika confirmed the loss date as 30 September 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Priya Gallagher gave a statement by phone.
Anika sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
